raw_text: Root `pom.xml` is Maven parent (packaging `pom`) aggregating modules: `ecommerce-common`, user/product/inventory/cart/order/payment/shipping services. Java 21, Maven 3.9+, Docker. Build: `mvn clean package`; one+deps: `mvn -pl user-service -am package`; run: `mvn -pl user-service spring-boot:run`; jar: `java -jar user-service/target/user-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`; stack: `docker compose up --build`. Code/config/tests: `<module>/src/main/java`, `<module>/src/main/resources/application.yml`, `<module>/src/test/java`; root `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`. 4-space Java, one public class/file; packages `com.example.ecommerce.<service>`. `UserController` `/api/...`; `User`, `OrderItem`; `UserRepository`; lowerCamelCase/UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Prefer Lombok and `ecommerce-common` types. No tests are checked in yet. Add new tests under `<module>/src/test/java`. Use JUnit 5 and Spring Boot testing support (`spring-boot-starter-test`) when introducing tests. Tests `*Test`/`*IT`; run `mvn test` or `mvn -pl order-service test`. Conventional Commits with module scope. PRs: summary, modules, API examples, schema/config notes; tests pass. Do not commit secrets; use environment credentials.
